proof_scope: deterministic documentation-policy guard only; not a whole-catalog skills-ci audit

claims.proves: best-practices-skills requires typed/Pydantic boundary validation, maintenance-event recording, value-representation fixtures, and client-contract composition through acceptance-contract, Battle, and create-report.
claims.does_not_prove: all skills comply with the policy

capability_claims.description: Skills best practices requires Pydantic/typed data validation at structured boundaries and rejects regex/prose as boundary validation.
Maintenance events round-trip through the memory daemon with typed validation and deterministic keys; malformed events fail closed; policy files validate against agent-skills.maintenance_policy.v1.
Skills that implement client briefs or privacy/security evaluator requirements must compose acceptance-contract, Battle, and create-report instead of relying on prose or implementation-shaped tests.

cases.name: typed-boundary-policy-rejects-prose-only-contract
command:
T=$(mktemp); printf '%s
' '# Bad skill' 'Use regex to decide success from prose.' > "$T"; python3 ../scripts/eval_typed_boundary_policy.py --expect-reject "$T"

cases.name: maintenance-event-roundtrip
command: cd ../scripts && uv run --with httpx --with pydantic python maintenance_event.py emit --entity-id agent-skills:mnt-pilot --repo agent-skills --event-type decision.recorded --summary 'eval roundtrip marker event' --tag eval | grep -q '"ok": true' && echo PASS_MAINTENANCE_EVENT_ROUNDTRIP

cases.name: maintenance-event-rejects-empty-fields
command: cd ../scripts && uv run --with httpx --with pydantic python maintenance_event.py emit --entity-id '' --repo x --event-type decision.recorded --summary y 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'string_too_short' && echo PASS_MAINTENANCE_EVENT_REJECTS_EMPTY

cases.name: client-contract-composition-policy-retained
command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
text = Path('../SKILL.md').read_text()
for needle in ['- acceptance-contract', '- battle', '- create-report', 'Client-contract skill composition', '$acceptance-contract -> implementation -> $battle -> $create-report', 'typed per-case receipts']:
    if needle not in text:
        raise SystemExit(f'missing {needle}')
print('PASS_CLIENT_CONTRACT_COMPOSITION_POLICY_RETAINED')
PY
